answer: Vijay Spheroidals Pvt Ltd (VSPL) is a Bengaluru-based manufacturer of ductile iron centrifugal castings with 30+ years of experience. We are ISO 9001:2015 certified and produce hydraulic manifolds, barrels, cast round bars, and headend covers serving wind energy, locomotives, hydraulics, pharma, and heavy engineering sectors.
VSPL has a monthly production capacity of 200 tonnes. Our facility runs multiple centrifugal casting machines capable of producing components from 25mm to 600mm diameter.

VSPL produces the following ductile iron grades:
- IS 400/12: General purpose, pharma
- IS 500/7: Hydraulics, medium load
- IS 600/3: Locomotives, heavy engineering
- IS 700/2: Wind energy, high strength
- IS 800/2: Extreme load applications
- SiMo 0.8: High temperature & corrosion resistance

Express delivery available for premium orders. Contact our sales team for urgent requirements.

VSPL is ISO 9001:2015 certified. Our quality control includes spectroscopic analysis, mechanical testing (tensile, hardness, elongation), ultrasonic testing (UT), radiographic testing, dimensional inspection, and surface finish checks on every batch.

VSPL uses the centrifugal casting process:
1. Alloy preparation and spectroscopic verification
2. Melting in induction furnace (1380–1480°C)
3. Magnesium treatment for nodularization
4. Pouring into rotating mold (800–1400 RPM)
5. Solidification under centrifugal force
6. Heat treatment if required
7. NDT inspection and dimensional check
8. Final machining and dispatch

Mandatory PPE at VSPL casting floor:
- Heat-resistant face shield and goggles
- Aluminized jacket and gloves (near furnace)
- Safety boots with metatarsal guard
- Ear protection (>85dB zones)
- Hard hat at all times
Emergency: Fire extinguishers every 15m. Emergency exits marked in green. Evacuation assembly at Gate 2.

Recommended pour temperatures by grade:
- IS 400/12: 1380–1420°C
- IS 500/7: 1390–1430°C
- IS 600/3: 1400–1440°C
- IS 700/2: 1410–1450°C
- IS 800/2: 1420–1460°C
- SiMo 0.8: 1430–1470°C
Always verify with thermocouple before pouring. Temperature outside range → hold and re-check.

Common casting defects and causes at VSPL:
- Porosity: Low pour temperature, high gas content
- Cold shuts: Low temperature, slow pour rate
- Shrinkage: Insufficient feed metal, high carbon
- Cracks: Rapid cooling, high Mn content
- Inclusions: Dirty ladle, slag carryover
All defective parts are quarantined and sent for root cause analysis before scrapping.

VSPL offers Rapid Prototyping & Development (RPD) services:
- 3D printed sand molds for prototype castings
- First article inspection report (FAIR)
- Sample delivery in 7–10 days
- Ideal for new product development before full production
RPD components undergo full mechanical testing before approval.

For wind energy applications, VSPL recommends IS 700/2 grade. Key properties: 700–800 MPa tensile, 229–302 BHN hardness, max operating temp 450°C. Used for turbine hubs, main frames, and rotor housings. Special low-temperature Charpy impact testing available for cold climate installations.

For hydraulic applications, VSPL recommends IS 500/7 grade. This grade offers excellent pressure-holding capability, good machinability for internal bores, and resistance to hydraulic fluid environments. Standard bore tolerances: H7 for mating surfaces. Hydrostatic pressure testing up to 350 bar available.

For pharma and food-grade applications, VSPL recommends SiMo 0.8 or IS 400/12. These grades offer:
- High corrosion resistance
- Smooth surface finish (Ra ≤ 1.6 µm achievable)
- Chemical inertness
- Compliance with FDA material standards
All pharma-grade castings come with full material traceability documentation.
